programme.title: Inheritors
programme.desc: Inheritors is a multi-media product from CGTN that shines a light on China's rich Intangible Cultural Heritage. Each 30-minute TV edition is hosted by a long-term expatriate in China who has a unique understanding of the country's culture. programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won't find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today's world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: Ibang Level 'to[Live]
programme.desc: is a news magazine show that features extraordinary, extreme, and outrageous stories about Pinoy subcultures, inspiring human-interest profiles, groundbreaking innovations, and trending social phenomena that go beyond the ordinary. Inspired by the viral TikTok hashtag 'Ibang Level,' the show connects naturally with the digital generation through engaging storytelling delivered in a fresh and conversational tone. With Melai Cantiveros' signature humor and MJ Felipe's wit, the duo brings a distinctly Filipino perspective to every story, immersing viewers in remarkable people, places, and experiences that are truly ibang level.

programme.title: The Crossings: Finding Our Way Home Through Stories[Live]
programme.desc: FAC films are all about Filipino stories-who we are, where we come from, and the experiences that shape us-told in both real-life and imaginative ways. FilAm Creative (FAC) is a nonprofit organization that supports Filipino and Filipino‑American creatives by providing opportunities, resources, and a platform to share their stories. It focuses on building community, developing talent, and promoting better representation in the entertainment industry.

programme.title: E18
programme.desc: 《山河之影》改編自路陽執導的同名系列電影《繡春刀》，講述兩位少年以赤子情懷協力衝破人生困境的江湖故事。 建文三年，雞鵝巷的小賊李霧濟南府金事王克恭攜萬貫家財平調進入南京城，便盜錦衣百戶李東方之名帖潛入王克恭府夢想著順利盜寶，在一夜之間坐擁菜華富貴。不料王克恭府中暗流湧動，李霧被迫捲入了一場圍繞魚瞑鎖展開的前朝火器之爭中，原本作為局外人的李霧成為了魚瞑鎖的持有者，陷入了漩渦中心。兒時，將李霧詔獄中解救的孩童宋真如今已成為錦衣衛陸錚，與李霧成了同僚，相見不相認；和李霧曾同處個囚室的女童舒棠變成了夜不收刺客，並跟李霧成了間諜夫妻，共同完成夜不收的任務。朝野紛爭的陰暗與殘酷讓三人之間的感情也在連環鎖樣的陰暗中經受著考驗。當改朝換代的那一刻到來的時候，所有的戰事和未解的迷局，都將落下帷幕。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 俞笑擁有一段令人外人羨慕的婚姻，然而因一起女高中生的遇害案，警察宋誠發現俞笑成了其與手頭一樁塵封舊案的共同證人，調查過程中，警方發現俞笑丈夫朱鶴好好男人的外表下，藏著無數與案件相關的線索。而對於俞笑而言，遇見宋誠和身份成謎的安妮後，她開始直面多年前的陰影……

programme.title: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: If karma does not exist, would you still choose kindness? programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……
